```python
def solve(case):
    payload = case["payload"]
    segments = payload["segments"]
    budget = payload["budget"]
    
    # Validate required fields
    for seg in segments:
        for field in ["name", "importance", "minimum", "capacity"]:
            if field not in seg:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing field {field} in segment")
    
    if "budget" not in payload:
        raise ValueError("Missing budget field")
    
    n = len(segments)
    names = [seg["name"] for seg in segments]
    importance = [seg["importance"] for seg in segments]
    minimums = [seg["minimum"] for seg in segments]
    capacities = [seg["capacity"] for seg in segments]
    
    quota_sum = sum(minimums)
    total_capacity = sum(capacities)
    
    # Validate budget
    if budget < quota_sum:
        raise ValueError(f"Budget {budget} below quota sum {quota_sum}")
    if budget > total_capacity:
        raise ValueError(f"Budget {budget} above total capacity {total_capacity}")
    
    # Initialize at minimum quotas
    allocations = list(minimums)
    remaining = budget - quota_sum
    
    # Greedy allocation
    while remaining > 0:
        best_idx = -1
        best_priority = -1
        
        for i in range(n):
            if allocations[i] >= capacities[i]:
                continue  # At capacity
            priority = importance[i] / (allocations[i] + 1)
            if best_idx == -1 or priority > best_priority:
                best_priority = priority
                best_idx = i
        
        if best_idx == -1:
            break  # All at capacity
        
        allocations[best_idx] += 1
        remaining -= 1
    
    # Build result
    name_mapping = {names[i]: allocations[i] for i in range(n)}
    
    return {
        "allocations": allocations,
        "name_mapping": name_mapping,
        "total": sum(allocations)
    }
```
